mapper.insert: insert into operation_log(operator_id, operator_name, operation_time, class_name, method_name, method_params, return_value, cost_time, operation_ip) values (#{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, #{operationTime}, #{className}, #{methodName}, #{methodParams}, #{returnValue}, #{costTime}, #{operationIp})
mapper.select: select id, operator_id, operator_name, operation_time, class_name, method_name, method_params, return_value, cost_time, operation_ip from operation_log order by operation_time desc, id desc
